hints.title: Timeline Changes
hints.text: Treat trip endpoints as events that alter the number of onboard passengers: add count at pickup and subtract at dropoff.

hints.title: Line Sweep Array
hints.text: Since locations are bounded up to 1000, build a difference array and apply prefix sums in chronological order.

hints.title: Capacity Threshold Check
hints.text: Maintain running occupancy; if at any coordinate the cumulative sum exceeds capacity, return false immediately.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating every individual mile for each passenger takes redundant nested loop passes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A fixed difference array of 1001 elements allows constant time boundary marking and linear sweep.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize this as a canonical difference array or line sweep interval problem.
complexity.notes: Passengers exit at location before new passengers enter at that same kilometer.
